mechanism: Haloperidol may impair glucose metabolism and reduce the efficacy of sitagliptin; sitagliptin metabolism involves minimal CYP450 interaction but haloperidol is metabolized by CYP3A4/CYP2D6 with potential for additive CNS effects.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely when combining these agents; consider alternative antipsychotics with less metabolic impact if glycemic control becomes problematic.
